snippets.text: - Good evening, everyone.

Before I officially call
our meeting to order,

on behalf of the board, I
want to take a few minutes

to ask that we remember
two of our ICCSD students
that we recently lost.

Wyatt Irvin, who is a
preschooler at Grant Elementary,

and Azari Lloyd, who is a
third grader at Kirkwood.
Both of their passing leaves a void

not only in their family lives
but also in their schools
and the greater ICCSD communities.

Wyatt was affectionately
called Pie, Wy-Guy, and Wy-Wy
by those that cherished him.

His loved ones described him
as having a contagious laugh
and a huge heart.
Wyatt will be lovingly remembered
as a funny, affectionate kid

who quickly connected
with adults in his life
and who loved being a big brother.

His family shared that he loved
reading, writing, counting,
playing with cards, swimming, splashing,

and exploring all things
related to dinosaurs.

He also greatly enjoyed
his days at the preschool
at Christine Grant Elementary

where he will be dearly
missed by teachers, staff,
and his many friends.

Our board extends our deepest
and heartfelt sympathies

to Wyatt's parents, Dylan Irvin
and Madeleine Drake-Metzger,
his mother, Trinity Graves,

his brother, Everett Irving,
and his extended family

as they hold tight to their
loving memories of Wyatt.

Azari Lloyd will be
remembered by his loved ones
as a child who brought light, laughter,
and love to the world.
His family and loved ones will hold tight
to the memories of him enjoying school,
cherishing his friends, dancing,
and listening to all kinds of music.

Azari has been described as
having an infectious laugh,
bright smile, and impressive dance moves

that had a special way of
turning even the darkest days
into a rainbow of delight.
- Those who loved Azari will hold tight

to the memories of his
strength, joy, and loving spirit
that will forever remain in their hearts.

Our board extends our deepest
and heartfelt sympathies

to Azari's parents, Angine
Cox, his father, Marzell Lloyd,

and his siblings, Atarus,
Amirra, Azi, and Zae,

as well as his many other
family members and friends
who will continue to honor Azari's memory.
- At this time, we ask that you join us

in a moment of silence
for both Wyatt and Azari.
Thank you.

I will call tonight's regular
board of directors meeting
to order.
Thank you to those attending in person
